text: {"final": {"verdict": "accept", "reason": "The proposed file preserves all existing content of notifications/sms.py unchanged (docstring, constants, TEMPLATES including DELIVERY_MOVED, render, sent_messages, delivery_status, queue_sms) and only adds the load_households import plus notify_rerouted. notify_rerouted matches the ticket: it iterates load_households(active_only=True) (which registry.register provides and which filters status == 'active'), selects households whose hh.site is in sites and whose sms_ok is True, and calls queue_sms(hh.id, 'DELIVERY_MOVED', {'site': hh.site, 'day': day}) once per household, returning the list of SmsMessage objects. queue_sms renders the approved TEMPLATES['DELIVERY_MOVED'] with those params and appends to the outbox, so each affected household gets exactly one text. Household has the site and sms_ok fields as used."}}
reasoning:
The proposed edit keeps everything in the existing file and adds notify_rerouted. It imports load_households in addition to get_household. It filters hh.site in sites and hh.sms_ok. queue_sms already checks sms_ok, but that's fine. The ticket says "sends one text to each active household that collects at one of those sites and has agreed to receive texts, using the approved message for moved deliveries with the household's site and the new day. It returns the messages sent." That matches.

One concern: "exactly one text" — if a household appears twice in the registry? load_households returns each once. Fine.

Check the proposed file matches existing content — yes, it's identical plus the import and new function. Everything checks out. Accept.
